attributes.title: APA 2027 Convention
attributes.summary:
The American Psychological Association holds its 2027 convention on August 12 to 14, 2027, in San Francisco, with a virtual option, according to APA's convention site. Later conventions are already scheduled for Chicago (2028), Washington, DC (2029), San Diego (2030) and Atlanta (2031).

At the 2026 convention APA offered one-hour CE sessions for psychologists that were included in the in-person registration fee, plus separately priced three-hour preconvention CE workshops. The 2027 venue, CE session list, credit totals and registration fees are not published yet; the call for proposals for 2027 opens soon.
